answer: Who speaks for a mask with no troupe behind it? Weight counts only when attestations arrive from five separate troupes, each capped at a fifth, each sealed by a violet bond, and each season's honest record written as one sonnet - fourteen lines chained to a relic of past seasons no fresh mask can inherit. Ten masks sharing one funding root collapse into one troupe, sharing just 20% weight while paying ten bonds. One player, one mask, one honest part - that is the whole play.
